observations.measure: Municipalities within consolidated audit universe
observations.note: Not all 257 audits were complete at the 31 January 2025 reporting cutoff.

observations.measure: Municipalities with completed audits by 31 January 2025
observations.note: Audit cutoff date is 2025-01-31, not report release.

observations.measure: Unqualified audit opinions with no findings (clean)
observations.note: Clean audit status is an audit opinion, not a direct service delivery outcome.

observations.measure: Unqualified audit opinions with findings
observations.note: Distinct from clean opinions.

observations.measure: Qualified audit opinions with findings
observations.note: Financial audit opinion, not criminal conviction.

observations.measure: Adverse audit opinions with findings
observations.note: Adverse opinion is not an adjudication of personal guilt.

observations.measure: Disclaimed audit opinions with findings
observations.note: Disclaimed opinion reflects inability to form audit opinion; not a criminal finding.

observations.measure: Audits outstanding at reporting cutoff
observations.note: Do not treat outstanding audits as adverse findings.

observations.measure: Material findings on compliance with key legislation
observations.note: Audit compliance finding is not a criminal verdict.

observations.measure: Material findings on usefulness or reliability of performance reports
observations.note: Not an independently measured resident satisfaction rate.

observations.measure: Municipalities with improved audit outcomes since 2020-21
observations.population: Municipalities compared by AGSA over administrative term
observations.denominator: 59 municipalities reported as improved; not a random sample
observations.note: Counterevidence to universal decline; not a causal impact estimate.

observations.measure: Municipalities with regressed audit outcomes since 2020-21
observations.population: Municipalities compared by AGSA over administrative term
observations.denominator: 40 municipalities reported as regressed; not a random sample
observations.note: Improved and regressed categories do not sum to total municipalities.

observations.measure: Municipalities late or failing to submit financial statements by legal deadline
observations.note: Submission timing is not a final audit opinion.

observations.measure: Municipalities submitting good-quality financial statements for audit
observations.note: Quality assessment is AGSA's audit classification, not population trust.

observations.measure: Clean municipal audit outcomes reported for 2022-23
observations.note: Historical snapshot; later audit completions may revise comparisons.

observations.measure: People registered as potentially affected by childcare-benefits scandal
observations.denominator: Approximately 69,400 people registered; not confirmed victims
observations.note: Approximate; do not equate registrations with established affected parents.

observations.measure: Parents officially established as affected
observations.denominator: Approximately 42,000 parents; subset of 69,400 potential registrants
observations.note: Rounded counts; not all registrants confirmed.

observations.measure: Parents whose integrated compensation assessments had been completed
observations.denominator: More than 64,000 parents; government separately reports 92.5% completion
observations.note: Reported as MORE THAN 64,000; 64,000 is a strict lower bound.

observations.measure: Share of integrated compensation assessments completed, as reported
observations.population: Registered remediation applicants in integrated review process
observations.denominator: Government-reported 92.5%; exact denominator and rounded counts not independently reconciled
observations.note: Do not calculate this percentage from rounded 64,000 and 69,400.

observations.measure: Children identified in data match as having been placed into care and linked to affected parents
observations.denominator: 1,819 children linked to 1,168 affected parents; 2005 onward matching
observations.note: Co-occurrence in administrative matching does NOT prove benefits errors caused any individual placement.

observations.measure: Affected parents identified with children placed into care
observations.population: Affected parents in cross-system data matching
observations.denominator: 1,168 parents associated with 1,819 identified children; incomplete ascertainment possible
observations.note: Not all care placements were caused by benefit recovery; official source says further analysis needed.

observations.measure: Cumulative redress paid across Horizon schemes
observations.denominator: £1,039 million cumulative across schemes by June 2025; not a budget allocation
observations.note: Government release says £1,039m; do not add the £245m subset to this total.

observations.measure: People receiving Horizon-related redress
observations.note: 7,300 is strict lower bound, not exact recipient count.

observations.measure: Payments under Horizon Convictions Redress Scheme
observations.note: Do not sum subset with overall total.

observations.measure: Urgent recommendations in Volume 1 of inquiry report
observations.denominator: 19 recommendations; not 19 sanctions or criminal findings
observations.note: Recommendations are not evidence of implementation.

observations.measure: Inquiry hearing days through evidence cutoff
observations.note: Approximate; hearing days are not affected persons.

observations.measure: Witnesses heard by inquiry through evidence cutoff
observations.note: Witnesses are not a sample of all affected postmasters.

observations.measure: Documents disclosed to Core Participants
observations.note: Document count not a measure of wrongdoing incidence.

events.subject: Dutch parliamentary childcare-benefits inquiry
events.finding: Parliamentary committee reported violations of fundamental rule-of-law principles in benefit fraud enforcement.
events.disposition: Institutional inquiry finding; not an individual criminal conviction.

events.subject: Dutch Public Prosecution Service and Tax Administration
events.finding: Prosecutors announced no criminal investigation into Tax Administration or employees for the assessed alleged extortion/professional discrimination; found no criminal suspicion on reviewed facts.
events.disposition: No prosecution initiated under this decision; NOT a court acquittal, and not a denial of documented administrative injustice.

events.subject: Rutte III cabinet
events.finding: Prime Minister publicly accepted political responsibility for childcare-benefits scandal and announced cabinet resignation.
events.disposition: Political accountability outcome; not a criminal sanction or individual finding of guilt.

events.subject: Dutch government
events.finding: Data linkage identified 1,819 children of 1,168 affected parents who had experienced care placement.
events.disposition: Offer of targeted support announced; individual causal links to benefits decisions not adjudicated by the data match.

events.subject: Auditor-General of South Africa
events.finding: Consolidated 2023-24 municipal audit results released, including 41 clean and 10 outstanding audits.
events.disposition: Independent institutional audit, not individual criminal verdict or measured public trust.

events.subject: Auditor-General of South Africa / Parliament
events.finding: Auditor-General briefed parliamentary committee on consolidated 2023-24 municipal audit outcomes.
events.disposition: Oversight hearing does not itself impose a sanction.

events.subject: UK Department for Business and Trade
events.finding: Government reported cumulative £1,039m paid to more than 7,300 postmasters.
events.disposition: Payments are actual reported redress, not criminal sanctions or proof all claims resolved.

events.subject: Dutch government
events.finding: Government acknowledged additional harm to children affected by benefits scandal and subsequent care orders, responding to Hamer Commission.
events.disposition: Acknowledgment and proposed support are not proof that all linked placements were caused by benefits errors.

events.subject: Dutch Ministry of Finance
events.finding: Government reported approximately 42,000 confirmed affected parents and more than 64,000 integrated assessments completed.
events.disposition: Progress figures reflect different applicant denominators; not proof all affected families have been fully restored.

events.subject: Post Office Horizon IT Inquiry
events.finding: Inquiry published Volume 1 on human impact and compensation, with 19 urgent recommendations.
events.disposition: Independent inquiry finding and recommendations; not a criminal conviction of any named individual.

methodology.denominatorGuardrail: South Africa 257 municipalities total, 247 completed audits at 2025-01-31 cutoff, 10 outstanding; 206/119 compliance/performance findings apply to 247 completed audits. Dutch 69,400 registrants, 42,000 confirmed, 64,000+ completed assessments and reported 92.5% are different/rounded quantities. UK £245m redress scheme is subset of £1,039m cumulative and >7,300 recipients is a strict lower bound.
methodology.statusGuardrail: Parliamentary inquiry finding, prosecutorial non-prosecution, political resignation, government acknowledgement, independent audit, compensation disbursement and recommendations must never be conflated with criminal guilt. Administrative matching does not establish causation of care placement.
methodology.dateGuardrail: Event dates are independently sourced publication or announcement dates; FY2023-24 South African municipal audit year ends 2024-06-30 and audit cutoff 2025-01-31; 2025 UK inquiry evidence cutoff 2025-06-06.
methodology.precisionGuardrail: Approximate and strict-lower-bound numbers remain labeled; do not derive unsupported rates or infer exact counts from rounded figures.
methodology.modelGuardrail: No causal estimate, misconduct ranking, claim of universal decline or trust association from these observations.
methodology.productionGuardrail: No changes to redistricting app feed, production APIs, frontend or UX; separate research-only JSON.
